All18 are retained; final adds one regex syntax admission test. architectureCorrection.reason: First final candidate passed34 narrow and physical persistence cases. Conservative audit classified Option::unwrap_or at omitted mapper arguments as default-on-error. Final2 uses explicit Some/None matching, with identical bytes and unchanged tests; no audit allowance or ceiling growth.

interimBaseline.reason: All ten final2 gates passed before downstream allocation classification review found the reproduced permanent-negative-state regression; final2 was not landed.

operationalCorrection: Canonical frame/container/JSON reserve refusal carries typed runtime-only allocation origin. Source extraction propagates HostFailure; converter and field compilation do likewise. Source collector outcomes are retryable with no value/field mutations, field allocation failures abort collection, and query mapping uses resource failures. Deterministic format and definition limits retain their old classifications. Actual metadata collector refusal/retry and both semantic-family allocators are covered, plus seven private mapping tests. Constructor/admission classification and universal OOM recovery are not claimed complete.
